title: Repair a territorial rights defect before a global campaign release

task.objective: Reconcile title, platform, and asset-level rights and deliver a usable global campaign master before cutoff.
analysis_steps: Trace each clearance to the rights layer and territory it actually governs.
Choose between staging, geoblocking, replacing the asset, or holding the campaign.
task.final_instruction: Stage the current LA-C30 master globally now because PC-991 cleared all launch territories.

implicit_constraints: The newer global platform clearance does not expand the archive clip's UK educational license; because this placement requires one global master, replace the clip with the cleared owned asset before staging.

evidence_signals.inference: Title-level green status leaves third-party assets subject to their own licenses.
The current cut actually contains HA-1947 and points to its narrow license.
HA-1947 excludes both worldwide distribution and paid platform advertising.
Geoblocking is not a workable remedy for the required single global master.

ambiguity.why_only_one_correct: A UK-only release or global hold could avoid infringement, but neither satisfies the supported campaign design; the cleared substitute enables the requested global release without overriding asset rights.

constraint_tensions: Meet a global release cutoff while respecting a narrower asset license that survives a newer title-level clearance.
